footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Array Technologies: after $59.8M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 40.2% to $1.3B in 2025. Gross margin was 23.2%, versus 32.5% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $29.0M from $227M.
The net loss narrowed to $112M, or −$0.73 per share, from $296M. Operating cash flow was $102M and free cash flow $79.8M, versus $147M.
sources: Array Technologies, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
